usedFor: Notion is where the team drafts content and Prismic is the CMS that publishes the website. An “Updated Content in Page” in Notion can run “Update Page” in Prismic, carrying the edited text into the matching site page.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Content in Page” in Notion, then “Update Page” in Prismic
bestTemplate.why: Edits to a Notion page are the likeliest sign that a site page needs to change. “Update Page” changes the content, UID, title or tags of an existing page.

watchOut: “Update Page” saves the change as a draft, so it needs a publish in Prismic before it goes live. It also acts on an existing page, so “New Page Is Created” cannot make a new one.
